message:
Baraka, Chidi and Dalia, the upsized cooling peak still runs on thin low-voltage wiring.

Plainly peak electricity is field heat plus wall leak divided by efficiency plus fans. The peak is 662 W from 1.04e3 W in the pull-down power (E57) plus 185 W wall leak in the steady load simulation (E31) divided by a Coefficient of Performance (COP) of 2, where Coefficient of Performance means cooling per electricity, plus fans, giving 13.8 A at 48 V in the peak current calculation (E61), like a small microwave on a household plug so ordinary solar cable carries it.

Baraka, Chidi and Dalia, the day energy and night store still cover staged loading without resizing.

Plainly one daily lot plus holding fits the sun and sleeps through the night. The need is 8 kWh per day in the array sizing (E16) from 3.78 kWh per day steady in the steady load simulation (E31) plus staged pull from 25 kWh in the pull-down energy (E56), met by 2.2 kW panels with 5.12 kWh store in the battery datasheet (E10) against about 4 kWh for a 12 h night, about half a household day so plausible.

I am not ready, because the blocking energy mismatch objection (O1) still needs Baraka to update the cooling concept and Chidi to revise the proposal to the agreed peak.
